page.overview:
What is Meditation Plane?

The Meditation Plane (also known as Bolas's Meditation Realm and after the War of the Spark as the Prison Realm) is a plane in the Multiverse. It is a surreal, always-changing plane whose geography can mirror the thoughts and potential futures of its inhabitants.

Before the Mending, the Meditation Plane was a subplane of Dominaria, believed by Ugin to be artificial. Accessible by the plane's inhabitants by astral projection, it was discovered by Ugin and later visited by Bolas on their first planeswalks millennia before the Mending. Other planes were accessible from here through bubbles floating in the air.

Jace Beleren described the plane as the very substrate of reality, touching countless worlds and moldable by sheer force of will. Learning from the mind of Loot, a Fomori, he claimed that the Elder Dragons had been too arrogant to utilise the realm's full potential.

Many, many times and adventures later, the two planeswalking brothers confronted each other. First above the wide waters of the Meditation Realm and then on a wild pummeling path through the planes, they struggled for days, years, and generations. In the end, by diverse paths, they returned to the Meditation Realm where Bolas killed Ugin. Monstrous waves rose from Ugin's fall into the water. The waves ran on and on, washing far beyond the bounds of the Meditation Realm into the web of connection that links the planes and the Blind Eternities. Bolas was flung through many planes before he fell hard back into Dominaria, onto the island chain of Madara.
